issuer: the Indonesian National Police (Kepolisian Negara Republik Indonesia)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Ministry of Finance's legal documentation network (JDIH Kemenkeu), which holds the full texts. Law No. 22 of 2009 on Road Traffic and Transport (Undang-Undang 22/2009) sets the minimum age for SIM A (cars) at 17 (art. 81(2)(a)), says a driving licence is valid for 5 years and can be extended (art. 85(2)), and that it is issued by the Indonesian National Police (art. 87(2)). Government Regulation No. 76 of 2020 (PP 76/2020) on the non-tax state revenue of the police sets the charge for testing for and issuing a new SIM A at Rp 120,000 per issue (Rp 80,000 for an extension, not held); the medical and psychological examinations aren't held. The text read of Law 22/2009 is its original text as JDIH Kemenkeu holds it; no later amendment of arts. 81, 85 or 87 was read. The identity card (KTP-el) is the ids engine's. No exchange list was read.
